basic_info.description: Welcome to 1530 Lawton Street, a beautifully renovated single-family home in San Francisco Central Sunset neighborhood. This 2,645 sq. ft residence seamlessly blends modern elegance with classic charm. A stylish finishing foyer warmly welcome you home, featuring four spacious bedrooms and four and a half bathrooms, the home is filled with natural light, high ceilings, hardwood floors, skylights, smart home system, and elegant lighting throughout. A full piece jade green decoration wall, add a touch of luxury and elegance in the living space. The chefs kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances and European-style counter space, ideal for cooking and entertaining. A large walk-in closet offers ample storage, while central heating ensures year-round comfort. The attached garage includes a separate entrance leading to a versatile in-law unit, perfect for guests or rental potential. Low-maintenance backyard, perfect for entertaining and enjoying a peaceful outdoor living. Located in one of the city's most desirable neighborhoods, this property offers convenient access to parks, schools, and public transportation. This home is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey home that combines luxury, practicality, and location perfect for todays modern homeowner.
